editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends renting a fancy Airbnb to hit up a massive music festival. That is exactly how things start here, and the vibe is all about parties, loud music, and college chaos. You get to know the group quickly, and while they seem like typical friends, there is a lot of tension beneath the surface. Things go south fast when a killer starts picking them off one by one. The scary part is that each death is tied to one of the seven deadly sins, making you wonder who is actually behind the masks and why they are doing this.

What really works here is the fast pace and the way it mixes laughs with screams. The acting is solid, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. A few scenes feel a bit predictable, but the gore and the energy make up for it. If you love slasher flicks that don't take themselves too seriously, you will love this one. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a big physical media fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: You find out that the killings were a calculated game of revenge. The twist reveals that the killer is someone within the group who wanted to punish their friends for past sins. After a final bloody showdown, the survivor manages to fight back and escape. The movie wraps up by showing that while the nightmare is over, the trauma and the secrets of the group are out in the open forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slasher movies with a twist.
